parts.steel-features:
AI Agents were never meant to browse the web.
Steel enables your Agents to browse like humans.

Control and start sessions with Sessions API A real browser, one API call.

  • Start a session in <1s

    A fresh browser ready before your agent asks twice.

  • Playwright, no agent needed

    Point your Playwright, Puppeteer or Selenium script at Steel and it runs.

  • Resume any session

    Pick up with the same cookies, tabs and state.

Read Sessions API docs
import Steel from "steel-sdk";
 
const client = new Steel();
const session = await client.sessions.create({
  solveCaptcha: true,
  useProxy: true,
});
- const browser = await puppeteer.launch();
+ const browser = await puppeteer.connect({
+   browserWSEndpoint: `wss://connect.steel.dev
+     ?apiKey=${KEY}&sessionId=${session.id}`,
+ });
const context = await client.sessions.context(session.id);
 
// Tomorrow, signed in as it was
const next = await client.sessions.create({
  sessionContext: context,
  timeout: 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000,
});

parts.steel-faq:
FAQ

View all FAQs
  • What is Steel and what does it do?

    Steel is cloud browser infrastructure for AI agents. It gives agents isolated cloud browser sessions with built-in anti-bot stealth, CAPTCHA solving and session persistence.

  • Can Steel bypass CAPTCHAs?

    Yes, on Steel Cloud. With CAPTCHA solving on, a session detects and solves CAPTCHAs as your agent browses, including Cloudflare Turnstile, PerimeterX press-and-hold and image CAPTCHAs, and the CAPTCHAs API reports each one's progress. Stealth and proxies keep many from appearing at all.

  • Is Steel open source?

    Yes. Steel Browser is the open-source server on GitHub that you can host yourself. Steel Cloud is the managed version, adding scale, stealth, proxies and CAPTCHA solving.

  • Can I use Steel with Playwright, Puppeteer or Selenium?

    Yes. Steel works with Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium and its own Node and Python SDKs. You connect over a standard CDP WebSocket URL, so any CDP-compatible tool works out of the box.

  • How fast does Steel start a browser session?

    Under a second on average, with no cold-start penalty. Each session launches into its own isolated Chromium in the cloud, with its proxy, cookies and storage already set up.

  • Does Steel support human-in-the-loop workflows and reusing logins?

    Yes. A live session viewer lets people watch or take over running sessions. Persistent browser profiles keep cookies and session tokens, so agents pick up signed-in workflows without logging in again.

  • How much does Steel cost, and is there a free tier?

    Launch includes $30 free credits, no monthly fee, and usage-based pricing after your one-time credits run out. Scale is $250 per month plus usage, and Enterprise pricing is custom. Steel Browser is free and open source.
